quests.hint: The lights in your house suddenly stopped working. Who could safely fix the wiring?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an electrician. Electricians install and repair the wires that bring us electricity.
quests.funFact: They must be incredibly careful because touching a live wire is extremely dangerous.
quests.wordExample: The electrician checked all the wires behind the wall.

quests.hint: Your wooden chair wobbled and broke a leg. Who could repair it for you?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a carpenter. Carpenters build and fix things made of wood, like tables and doors.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they use a loud, spinning circular saw to cut a perfectly straight line.
quests.wordExample: The carpenter built a wooden chair for the kitchen.

quests.hint: You visit the zoo and see someone feeding the lions their lunch. Who is that?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a zookeeper. Zookeepers feed and care for animals living at the zoo.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they closely monitor the animals to make sure they are completely healthy and happy.
quests.wordExample: The zookeeper cleaned the lions' habitat carefully.

quests.hint: The _____ fixed the tiny gears inside the watch.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a watchmaker. Watchmakers build and repair watches with tiny, careful parts.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a watchmaker uses a magnifying glass to perfectly place tiny, microscopic gears inside a watch.
quests.wordExample: The watchmaker fixed the tiny gears inside the watch.

quests.hint: This person studies the rules carefully and speaks up for someone in court, rather than making the final decision. Are they a lawyer or a judge?
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a lawyer. Lawyers help and speak for people who need help with the law.
quests.funFact: They dramatically argue with the opposing side to convince a jury of the absolute truth.
quests.wordExample: The lawyer spoke carefully on behalf of her client in court.

quests.hint: You feel stressed and want to learn how to relax and stretch calmly. Who could teach you?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a yoga instructor. Yoga instructors teach calm stretches and breathing exercises.
quests.funFact: A yoga instructor teaches people how to stretch their muscles and breathe incredibly deeply.
quests.wordExample: The yoga instructor helped me hold the pose steady.

quests.hint: You love the colorful pictures inside your favorite storybook. Who drew them?
quests.explanation: Yes! This is an illustrator. Illustrators draw the pictures that appear inside books.
quests.funFact: An illustrator draws the beautiful, colorful pictures you completely love in a children's book.
quests.wordExample: The illustrator drew a colorful picture of the dragon.

quests.hint: The _____ shaped the clay model before starting the real statue.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a sculptor. Sculptors carve or shape material like stone or metal into art.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they often mold soft, squishy clay with their thumbs before casting it in heavy bronze.
quests.wordExample: The sculptor shaped the clay model before starting the real statue.

quests.hint: You want to hear your favorite song performed live at a concert. Who sings it on stage?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a singer. Singers use their voice to perform songs.
quests.funFact: A singer practices for hours to perfectly hit an incredibly high, powerful musical note.
quests.wordExample: The singer performed her new song on stage.

quests.hint: You're on a long flight and would like a blanket and something to drink. Who could help you?
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a flight attendant. Flight attendants help passengers stay safe and comfortable on an airplane.
quests.funFact: A flight attendant perfectly demonstrates exactly how to use a yellow oxygen mask in an emergency.
quests.wordExample: The flight attendant showed us where the exits were.

quests.hint: You finished an amazing book and want to read more stories by the very same person. Who wrote it?
quests.explanation: Yes! This is an author. Authors write books for people to read and enjoy.
quests.funFact: An author completely invents massive, magical worlds entirely out of their own brilliant imagination.
quests.wordExample: The author read the first chapter aloud to the class.

quests.hint: You want a special ring made with a sparkling gem as a gift. Who could design and make it?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a jeweler. Jewelers design and make jewelry from gems and precious metals.
quests.funFact: A jeweler uses microscopic tools to fix the tiny gears inside a broken watch.
quests.wordExample: The jeweler fixed the clasp on my necklace.

quests.hint: Your tooth has been hurting and needs a check-up. Who should you visit?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a dentist. Dentists check and clean teeth to keep your smile healthy.
quests.funFact: A dentist uses a tiny, completely round mirror to clearly see the very back of your hidden teeth.
quests.wordExample: I visit the dentist every year for a check-up.

quests.hint: Your family wants fresh fish for dinner tonight. Who caught it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a fisherman. Fishermen catch fish from the sea, rivers, or lakes.
quests.funFact: A fisherman wakes up when it is pitch black to perfectly cast a heavy net into the freezing ocean.
quests.wordExample: The fisherman sailed out early to catch fresh fish.

quests.hint: You wonder how we know so much about what happened hundreds of years ago. Who studies that?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a historian. Historians study events from the past to understand history.
quests.funFact: They write books explaining exactly why ancient empires eventually collapsed.
quests.wordExample: The historian explained how people lived long ago.

quests.hint: Your family wants to move to a bigger house in a new neighborhood. Who helps you find one?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a real estate agent. Real estate agents help people find and buy the right home.
quests.funFact: An agent helps negotiate the price so the buyer gets a great deal.
quests.wordExample: The real estate agent answered all our questions about the home.

quests.hint: You're swimming at a crowded pool on a hot day. Who is watching closely to keep everyone safe?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a lifeguard. Lifeguards watch swimmers closely and keep everyone safe at the pool or beach.
quests.funFact: They must pass a very difficult test to prove they are a powerful swimmer.
quests.wordExample: The lifeguard watched the swimmers from a tall chair.

quests.hint: Two people disagree about something important and need someone fair to help settle it. Who decides in court?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a judge. Judges listen carefully and decide what is fair in court.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a judge listens carefully to all the evidence to ensure a fair trial in court.
quests.wordExample: The judge asked both sides to explain what happened.

quests.hint: A visitor at school speaks a language your teacher doesn't understand. Who could help them talk to each other?
quests.explanation: Yes! This is an interpreter. Interpreters listen in one language and speak the meaning in another right away.
quests.funFact: An interpreter listens to someone speak Spanish and instantly translates it perfectly into English.
quests.wordExample: The interpreter helped the visitor understand the doctor's questions.

quests.hint: You're watching a band play their instruments at a lively concert. Who is playing the guitar?
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a musician. Musicians play instruments to create music.
quests.funFact: A musician expertly presses the black and white keys of a piano to play a completely beautiful song.
quests.wordExample: The musician played a cheerful tune on his guitar.

quests.hint: Something on the bottom of a boat needs to be checked and fixed underwater. Who could do that safely?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a diver. Divers explore underwater using special equipment to help them breathe.
quests.funFact: A diver might explore sunken ships or weld broken metal pipes entirely underwater.
quests.wordExample: The diver checked her equipment before jumping into the sea.

quests.hint: You want to try climbing a real rock cliff for the first time, safely. Who could guide you?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a rock climbing guide. Rock climbing guides lead climbers safely up steep rocks.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a climbing guide uses strong ropes and carabiners to keep you safe on a steep cliff.
quests.wordExample: The rock climbing guide pointed out the next hand hold.

quests.hint: Your family is going on a cruise across the ocean. Who steers the huge ship and keeps everyone safe?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a ship captain. Ship captains lead the crew and steer a ship across the sea.
quests.funFact: A ship captain is the absolute boss of a massive, heavy metal cargo ship sailing the deep ocean.
quests.wordExample: The ship captain steered the ship safely into port.

quests.hint: You're locked out of your house and can't find your key anywhere. Who could help you get back inside?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a locksmith. Locksmiths make and fix locks and keys.
quests.funFact: A locksmith helps families keep their homes incredibly safe and perfectly secure.
quests.wordExample: The locksmith helped us open the lock when the key broke.

quests.hint: Long ago, if your family needed a metal tool made or repaired, who would you visit in town?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a blacksmith. Blacksmiths shape hot metal into tools and other useful objects.
quests.funFact: A blacksmith dips hot metal into a bucket of cold water to harden it instantly.
quests.wordExample: The blacksmith hammered the glowing metal into shape.

quests.hint: You wonder where the wood used to build a wooden house comes from. Who cuts it down?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a lumberjack. Lumberjacks cut down trees to get wood for building.
quests.funFact: Modern lumberjacks use massive chainsaws instead of hand axes.
quests.wordExample: The lumberjack worked carefully in the tall forest.

quests.hint: You found a strange bug in the garden and want to know what kind it is. Who could identify it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an entomologist. Entomologists study insects like ants, beetles, and butterflies.
quests.funFact: Did you know? an entomologist is a specialized scientist who studies millions of different crawling insects.
quests.wordExample: The entomologist studied a butterfly's wings closely.

quests.hint: You're at a restaurant and can't wait to eat something delicious. Who is cooking your meal in the kitchen?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a chef. Chefs cook tasty meals in restaurants.
quests.funFact: A chef completely memorizes dozens of incredibly complicated recipes to cook at a fancy restaurant.
quests.wordExample: The chef cooked a delicious pizza for dinner.

quests.hint: You're watching cars zoom around a track at incredible speed. Who is behind the wheel?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a race car driver. Race car drivers race fast cars around a track.
quests.funFact: A race car driver steers an incredibly loud car moving over two hundred miles per exact hour.
quests.wordExample: The race car driver crossed the finish line first.

quests.hint: You wonder where the metal used to make coins or jewelry originally comes from. Who digs it up?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a miner. Miners dig deep underground to find coal, metal, or gems.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they wear special helmets with bright lights because caves are completely dark.
quests.wordExample: The miner dug carefully to find pieces of coal.
